title: I Married My Enemy—Then My Dead Sister Walked In
logline: A revenge bride completes her fake marriage and publicly attacks her enemy's empire, only to discover her presumed-dead sister is alive and allied with her groom.
target_audience: US women ages 18–34 who binge dark romance, fake-marriage drama, revenge stories, and betrayal twists.
hook: I married the enemy to destroy his family. At the altar, he whispered, “Your sister helped me destroy yours.”
synopsis: Elena Cross marries Adrian Vale to gain access to the empire she plans to destroy. When Adrian reveals that her missing sister betrayed her, Elena completes the vows anyway and steals his keycard. She storms the boardroom and publishes the Vale family's secret records, but her victory collapses when Mara appears alive and reveals that Elena's move exposed their mother's location.
episode_goal: Show Elena choosing revenge over retreat, executing a public attack on the Vale empire, and discovering that her trusted sister may be the true architect of her pain.
